phrase.en: Apple shuns AI race, wins big
phrase.zh: 苹果避开AI竞赛大获全胜
谷歌支出激增震动投资者

phrase.en: Korean chip stocks plunge on AI fears
phrase.zh: 韩国芯片股因AI担忧暴跌

gloss.en: Wall Street is spooked by the soaring cost of AI, triggering a sell-off that rattles markets worldwide.
gloss.zh: 华尔街被飙升的AI成本吓到，引发抛售，震荡全球市场。

why_now.en: You follow AI and markets: today Google's capex hike and Apple's $5T valuation show the divide between AI spenders and abstainers.
why_now.zh: 你关注AI与市场：今日谷歌资本支出上调与苹果市值破五万亿，揭示了AI投入者与旁观者的分野。

phrase.en: Most jobs untouched by AI automation
phrase.zh: 多数工作未被AI自动化触及

phrase.en: AI leaders fear automated AI, urge regulation
phrase.zh: AI领导者担忧自动化AI，敦促监管

gloss.en: Real-world data shows AI is not replacing jobs broadly, yet industry insiders call for government action against automated AI.
gloss.zh: 真实数据显示AI并未广泛取代工作，但业内人士呼吁政府应对自动化AI。

why_now.en: You track LLM & AI: Google's internal study and a joint statement by AI leaders give two contrasting views on AI's job effect today.
why_now.zh: 你跟踪LLM与AI：谷歌内部研究和AI领导者联合声明今日提供了关于AI就业影响的两种对立观点。

phrase.en: Explainable AI boosts trust in code review
phrase.zh: 可解释AI提升代码审查信任

phrase.en: Agentic AI speeds up scientific computing

gloss.en: AI agents are transforming scientific computing and code review, but trust in their reasoning remains a hurdle.
gloss.zh: AI智能体正在改变科学计算与代码审查，但对其推理的信任仍是障碍。

why_now.en: You are into LLM and embodied AI: today's papers and OpenAI report push AI agents from hype to practical use in science.
why_now.zh: 你关注LLM与具身AI：今日论文和OpenAI报告将AI智能体从炒作推向科学实践应用。
